plugin.name: Finger_Notes
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Keep your own note on a player and show it at the bottom of their finger

muclient.script:
local VERSION = "1.1" local TAG = "FNotes"
local CLR_TAG = "#875FFF" -- x099 local CLR_NAME = "#00D7FF" -- x045 local CLR_MSG = "#FFFFFF" -- W local CLR_HI = "#00FF87" -- x048
local WIDTH = 60 -- finger output is 60 columns wide local PENDING_SECS = 5 -- longest a finger may take to reach its rule
local DATA_NAME = "FNotes_data.txt"
local HELP = { { cmd = "fnote <player> <note>", desc = "add a note, or replace the existing one" }, { cmd = "fnote <player>", desc = "show the note on a player" }, { cmd = "fnote clear <player>", desc = "remove the note on a player" }, { cmd = "fnote help", desc = "this help" }, { cmd = "fnote list", desc = "show every note" }, { cmd = "fnote reload", desc = "reload the plugin" }, } table.sort (HELP, function (a, b) return a.cmd < b.cmd end)
local gNotes = {} -- lowercase name -> note text local gPending = nil -- lowercase name waiting for the closing rule local gPendingAt = 0 -- os.time() the header was seen
local function echo (msg) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", msg) end
-- Echo with one highlighted value in the middle of the sentence. local function echoHi (before, value, after) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", before, CLR_HI, "", value, CLR_MSG, "", after or "") end
local function displayName (key) return key:sub (1, 1):upper () .. key:sub (2) end
---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Word wrap ----------------------------------------------------------------------
function FNote_Wrap (text, width) local lines, cur = {}, "" for word in text:gmatch ("%S+") do -- A word too long for any line is split, filling whole lines. while #word > width do if cur ~= "" then lines [#lines + 1] = cur cur = "" end lines [#lines + 1] = word:sub (1, width) word = word:sub (width + 1) end if cur == "" then cur = word elseif #cur + 1 + #word <= width then cur = cur .. " " .. word else lines [#lines + 1] = cur cur = word end end if cur ~= "" then lines [#lines + 1] = cur end return lines end
-- "label: text", wrapped, continuation lines under the first word. local function printBlock (label, labelColour, text) local head = label .. ": " local lines = FNote_Wrap (text, WIDTH - #head) ColourNote (labelColour, "", label, CLR_TAG, "", ": ", CLR_MSG, "", lines [1] or "") local indent = string.rep (" ", #head) for i = 2, #lines do ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", indent .. lines [i]) end end
local function printNote (key) printBlock ("Note", CLR_NAME, gNotes [key]) end
---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Storage ----------------------------------------------------------------------
local function dataPath () local pluginFile = GetPluginInfo (GetPluginID (), 6) or "" local pluginDir = pluginFile:match ("^(.*[\\/])") or "" return pluginDir .. DATA_NAME end
local function loadNotes () gNotes = {} local path = dataPath () local f = io.open (path, "rb") or io.open (path .. ".tmp", "rb") if not f then return end for row in f:lines () do local key, text = row:match ("^([^\t]+)\t(.-)%s*$") if key and text ~= "" then gNotes [key:lower ()] = text end end f:close () end
local function saveNotes () local keys = {} for key in pairs (gNotes) do keys [#keys + 1] = key end table.sort (keys)
local rows = {} for _, key in ipairs (keys) do rows [#rows + 1] = key .. "\t" .. gNotes [key] .. "\n" end
local path = dataPath () local tmp = path .. ".tmp" local f, err = io.open (tmp, "wb") if not f then echo ("Could not save notes: " .. tostring (err)) return false end f:write (table.concat (rows)) f:close () os.remove (path) local ok, rerr = os.rename (tmp, path) if not ok then echo ("Could not save notes: " .. tostring (rerr)) return false end return true end
---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Finger display ----------------------------------------------------------------------
function FNote_Header (name, line, wildcards) local key = wildcards [1]:lower () if gNotes [key] then gPending = key gPendingAt = os.time () EnableTrigger ("fnote_footer", true) else gPending = nil EnableTrigger ("fnote_footer", false) end end
-- Runs after the rule has been gagged (send_to 14), so printing order is -- simply: note, blank line, rule. function FNote_Footer (rule) EnableTrigger ("fnote_footer", false)
local key = gPending gPending = nil if key and gNotes [key] and os.time () - gPendingAt <= PENDING_SECS then printNote (key) Note ("") end
local runs = TriggerStyleRuns if type (runs) == "table" and runs [1] and runs [1].text then for _, v in ipairs (runs) do ColourTell (RGBColourToName (v.textcolour), RGBColourToName (v.backcolour), v.text) end Note ("") else Note (rule) end end
---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Commands ----------------------------------------------------------------------
local function showHelp () ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", "Version ", CLR_HI, "", VERSION, CLR_MSG, "", " - your own notes, shown when you finger a player") local pad = 0 for _, h in ipairs (HELP) do pad = math.max (pad, #h.cmd) end for _, h in ipairs (HELP) do ColourNote (CLR_HI, "", " " .. h.cmd .. string.rep (" ", pad - #h.cmd + 2), CLR_MSG, "", h.desc) end end
local function showList () local keys = {} for key in pairs (gNotes) do keys [#keys + 1] = key end table.sort (keys) if #keys == 0 then echo ("No notes yet.") return end echoHi ("Notes: ", tostring (#keys)) for _, key in ipairs (keys) do printBlock (displayName (key), CLR_HI, gNotes [key]) end end
local function clearNote (key) if not gNotes [key] then echoHi ("No note set for ", displayName (key), ".") return end local old = gNotes [key] gNotes [key] = nil if saveNotes () then echoHi ("Cleared the note for ", displayName (key), ".") else gNotes [key] = old end end
local function setNote (key, text) local old = gNotes [key] gNotes [key] = text if not saveNotes () then gNotes [key] = old return end if old then echoHi ("Replaced the note for ", displayName (key), ". It was:") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " " .. old) echo ("It now reads:") else echoHi ("Note set for ", displayName (key), ":") end printNote (key) end
function FNote_Cmd (name, line, wildcards) local args = (wildcards [1] or ""):gsub ("%s+", " ") local lower = args:lower ()
if args == "" or lower == "help" then showHelp () return end if lower == "list" then showList () return end if lower == "reload" then echo ("Reloading...") Execute (GetAlphaOption ("script_prefix") .. 'DoAfterSpecial(1, "ReloadPlugin(\'' .. GetPluginID () .. '\')", sendto.script)') return end
local who = lower:match ("^clear (%a+)$") if who then clearNote (who) return end
local player, text = args:match ("^(%a+) (.+)$") if not player then player, text = args:match ("^(%a+)$"), "" end if not player then echo ("That is not a player name. Type fnote help for the commands.") return end player = player:lower ()
if text == "" then if gNotes [player] then printNote (player) else echoHi ("No note set for ", displayName (player), ".") end return end
setNote (player, text) end
function OnPluginInstall () loadNotes () local count = 0 for _ in pairs (gNotes) do count = count + 1 end ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", "Version ", CLR_HI, "", VERSION, CLR_MSG, "", " loaded with ", CLR_HI, "", tostring (count), CLR_MSG, "", count == 1 and " note. Type " or " notes. Type ", CLR_HI, "", "fnote", CLR_MSG, "", " for help.") end
